review.posthog_relevance: CI workflow execution and compatibility documentation
review.reason: The change removes GitHub-native parallel execution blocks and replaces them with sequential execution, preventing runner crashes caused by concurrent writes to $GITHUB_PATH. This is a reliability improvement. Documentation is updated to clarify compatibility risks between GitHub Actions and Depot CI. No tier 3 systemic change is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: Tier assignment relies on the interpretation of CI workflow changes and documentation updates; no runtime behavior or production incident avoidance is demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the observed removal of parallel execution and its replacement with sequential execution, which is a bounded reliability improvement.
